text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS Active fire / thermal anomaly detections, there were no fire detections intersecting the asset ASSET-F02 during the period from September 25, 2026, to October 25, 2026. The sensors VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS covered the asset for most of the period, with the exception of the last day, which was not covered due to the latest NRT file update not being published yet. Therefore, it can be concluded that there was no fire on this asset during the evaluated period.
